In a conversation on 25 May 2023 at 1:14 pm, Melanie told Caroline that since Melanie and Caroline last chatted, Melanie had a lot of things happening. Melanie ran a charity race for mental health on Saturday, 20 May 2023. Melanie said the charity race was really rewarding and made Melanie think about taking care of minds.

On 25 May 2023, Melanie told Caroline that Caroline taking in kids in need is awesome. Melanie said Caroline is kind and Caroline's future family will be lucky to have Caroline.

On 25 May 2023, Melanie told Caroline that Melanie loved the inclusivity and support. Melanie asked Caroline whether there was anything Caroline was excited for in the adoption process.
On 25 May 2023, Caroline said Caroline is thrilled to make a family for kids who need one. Caroline said it will be tough as a single parent, but Caroline is up for the challenge.

On 25 May 2023, Melanie told Caroline that Caroline is doing something amazing. Melanie said creating a family for kids who need one is lovely. Melanie said Caroline will be an awesome mom and wished Caroline good luck.

On 25 May 2023, Caroline thanked Melanie. Caroline said Melanie's kind words really mean a lot. Caroline said Caroline will do Caroline's best to make sure the kids Caroline hopes to adopt have a safe and loving home.

On 25 May 2023, Melanie told Caroline that Melanie has no doubts. Melanie said Caroline has such a caring heart and the kids Caroline hopes to adopt will get all the love and stability they need. Melanie said Melanie is excited for this new chapter.
On 25 May 2023, Caroline sometimes called Melanie 'Mel' as a nickname during the conversation.

Caroline told Melanie that Caroline attended a school event in the week before 9 June 2023, specifically during the week of 29 May 2023 to 4 June 2023, where Caroline talked about Caroline's transgender journey and encouraged students to get involved in the LGBTQ community.
Caroline started transitioning three years before 9 June 2023, around June 2020.
Melanie told Caroline that Melanie was proud of Caroline for spreading awareness and getting others involved in the LGBTQ community.
Caroline shared at the school event Caroline's own journey, the struggles Caroline had, and how much Caroline had developed since coming out.
Caroline felt super powerful giving Caroline's talk and saw that the audience related to what Caroline said and was inspired to be better allies.
Caroline believes conversations about gender identity and inclusion are necessary and is thankful for being able to give a voice to the trans community.
Melanie told Caroline that Caroline is doing an awesome job inspiring others with Caroline's journey, and Melanie is glad to be part of it.
Melanie thinks talking about inclusivity and acceptance is crucial and that Caroline is brave to speak up for the trans community.

Caroline feels sharing experiences is not always easy but is important to help promote understanding and acceptance. Caroline has been blessed with loads of love and support throughout Caroline's journey and wants to pass that love and support on to others.
Caroline believes that by sharing stories, people can build a strong, supportive community of hope.
Melanie said it takes courage to talk about one's own stories, and that in vulnerable moments people bond and understand each other.
Melanie thanked Caroline for using Caroline's voice to create love, acceptance, and hope.
Caroline is grateful for the chance to share Caroline's story and give others hope, and Caroline plans to keep using Caroline's voice to make a change and lift others up.
Melanie thanked Caroline for letting Melanie join Caroline's journey, and Melanie is proud to be part of the difference Caroline is making.
Caroline and Melanie agreed to spread love and understanding, tackle life's challenges together, and support each other.
Melanie wants to be courageous for Melanie's family, who motivate Melanie and give Melanie love.
Caroline said Caroline's friends, family, and mentors are Caroline's rocks; they motivate Caroline and give Caroline strength to push on.
Caroline shared a photo of a family posing for a picture in a yard, from when Caroline met up with them in the week before 9 June 2023, the week of 29 May 2023 to 4 June 2023.
Melanie said Caroline's photo was great and asked how long Caroline had had such a great support system.
Caroline has known these friends for 4 years, since Caroline moved from Caroline's home country, which was about four years before 9 June 2023, around June 2019.
Caroline said these friends' love and help have been very important, especially after a tough breakup Caroline experienced.
Melanie is supported by Melanie's husband and kids; they keep Melanie motivated.
Melanie shared a photo of a man and a little girl standing in front of a waterfall.
Caroline asked Melanie how long Melanie had been married.
Melanie has been married for 5 years as of 9 June 2023, so Melanie married around June 2018.
Melanie shared a photo of Melanie as a bride in a wedding dress holding a bouquet.
Caroline congratulated Melanie, said Melanie and Melanie's spouse looked great on their wedding day, and wished Melanie many happy years together.
Melanie thanked Caroline, said Melanie appreciates Caroline's kind words, and said Melanie is looking forward to more happy years; Melanie's family and moments make it all worth it.
Melanie shared a photo of a man and woman sitting on a blanket eating food.
Caroline said the photo looked like Melanie had a great day and asked Melanie how it was.
Melanie said the day was fun; Melanie and Melanie's family played games, ate good food, and hung out together, and family moments make life awesome.
Caroline said Caroline is glad Melanie had a great time and told Melanie to cherish the moments.
Melanie said Melanie cherishes time with family and that it is when Melanie really feels alive and happy.
Caroline agreed that hanging with loved ones is amazing and brings so much happiness, and Caroline said those moments make Caroline thankful and that family is everything.

Caroline is thankful for the LGBTQ community and believes it is important to fight for trans rights and spread awareness.
Melanie was glad that Caroline felt accepted and supported, and Melanie thinks events like the LGBTQ conference remind people how strong community can be.
Caroline believes having people who support you makes a huge difference. Caroline believes LGBTQ rights have come far but more progress is needed, and Caroline wants to help make a difference.

Caroline struggled with mental health, and the support Caroline received was helpful. This made Caroline realize how important it is for others to have a support system. Caroline started looking into counseling and mental health career options to help other people on their journeys as Caroline was helped.
Melanie was glad Caroline got support, said Caroline's experience brought Caroline to where Caroline needs to be, and said Caroline is going to make a huge difference.
Melanie read a book in 2022 that reminds Melanie to always pursue Melanie's dreams, just as Caroline is pursuing Caroline's dreams. Melanie shared a photo of a book cover with a gold coin on it.

Caroline loves reading. Books guide Caroline, motivate Caroline, and help Caroline discover who Caroline is; books are a huge part of Caroline's journey. A book photo from Melanie reminded Caroline to keep going and never give up.
Melanie said books have awesome power and asked Caroline which book has been Caroline's favorite guide.

Caroline's favorite guide book is "Becoming Nicole" by Amy Ellis Nutt. Caroline describes it as a real inspiring true story about a trans girl and that girl's family; it made Caroline feel connected and gave Caroline hope for Caroline's own path. Caroline highly recommends it. Caroline shared a photo of a dog sitting in a boat on the water.
Melanie asked what Caroline took away from "Becoming Nicole" to use in Caroline's life.

Caroline asked Melanie what got Melanie into running.
Caroline said running can boost Melanie's mood and encouraged Melanie to keep running.
Melanie said running has been great for Melanie's mental health and Melanie is going to keep running. Melanie said mental health is important to Melanie and running has made such an improvement.

Caroline is glad running helped Melanie.

Caroline's favorite color is blue, which makes her feel relaxed. Caroline thinks sunflowers mean warmth and happiness, and roses stand for love and beauty. Melanie's favorite part was marrying her partner and promising to be together forever. Caroline wishes she had known Melanie at the time of Melanie's wedding. Photos shared: a wedding ceremony in a greenhouse with people taking pictures; a man and woman standing on a beach.

A few weeks before 15 July 2023 (around late June/early July 2023), Caroline went to a pride parade and joined in. It was amazing; Caroline felt accepted and happy being around people who accepted and celebrated her. She felt proud and grateful, and it was comforting to know she is not alone and has a great community around her. It inspired her. Melanie noted that Caroline's friends and community really have her back. Photos shared: a parade with people walking down the street; a group of people holding up signs and smiling; a rainbow flag on a pole on a carpet; a group of people sitting on the ground with a dog; a girl sitting in a teepee with stuffed animals.

Melanie said Caroline found the courage to be herself, which is important for mental health and finding peace. Photos shared: a teepee with a teddy bear and pillows; a buddha statue and a candle on a table.

Caroline is glad to have Melanie as a friend to share her journey, and Caroline thinks Melanie is awesome. Melanie appreciates Caroline's friendship and is glad to have Caroline as a supporter. Caroline says Melanie's friendship means so much to her.
